crossRefs.note: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over…
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness…

translations.web: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
translations.bsb: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
translations.kjv: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove
translations.asv: Let not the foot of pride come against me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.
